Test fixtures. manifest.json maps each URL to its file, HTTP status, content type and retrieval time (UTC).

bdi_* files: SYNTHETIC
  Generated by scripts/make_fixtures.py. They reproduce the layout of the Banca d'Italia Base Dati
  Statistica (BDS) A2A export (zip of ';'-separated CSV, decimal comma, dates YYYY/MM/DD), but
  every value and every title is invented. They contain no Banca d'Italia statistics.
  Series keys follow the real naming scheme. From 2003-01, BAM values are the ECB fixture value
  plus an offset of at most 0.004, so the BdI-vs-ECB consistency test stays meaningful.
  bdi_rejected.html and bdi_invalid.html are synthetic stand-ins for the firewall rejection page
  (HTTP 200) and the invalid-object page (HTTP 400).
  A test checks that the committed files equal the generator's output.

ecb_* files: RECORDED, unmodified
  Source: European Central Bank, ECB Data Portal, SDMX 2.1 REST API
  https://data-api.ecb.europa.eu/service/data/MIR/M.IT.B.A2A.A.R.A+0+1.2240.EUR.N?format=csvdata&startPeriod=2003-01
  Retrieved 2026-10-23. Source: ECB statistics.
  Reuse terms: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/ecb_statistics/governance_and_quality_framework/html/usage_policy.en.html
  (free reuse with the source quoted and the statistics, including metadata, not modified).
  Re-record with: python scripts/record_fixtures.py
